name: Chucky
description: After a vintage Chucky doll turns up at a suburban yard sale, an idyllic American town is thrown into chaos as a series of horrifying murders begin to expose the town’s hypocrisies and secrets. Meanwhile, the arrival of enemies — and allies — from Chucky’s past threatens to expose the truth behind the killings, as well as the demon doll’s untold origins.

videos.title: Death by Misadventure
videos.overview: When teen Jake Wheeler buys a vintage doll at a yard sale, his young life changes forever.

videos.title: Give Me Something Good to Eat
videos.overview: Chucky targets one of Jake's frenemies, forcing Jake to either stop the killer doll – or help him.

videos.title: I Like to Be Hugged
videos.overview: Chucky reminisces about his first murder, urging Jake to make a choice -- kill or be killed.

videos.title: Just Let Go
videos.overview: Jake's bond with Devon intensifies as he teams up with an unlikely ally to outwit Chucky.

videos.title: Little Little Lies
videos.overview: Jake and Devon are ready to take their relationship to the next level—but after another gruesome murder at Chucky's far-from-idle hands, who has time for romance? Meanwhile, enemies—and allies—from Chucky's past show up to complicate matters.

videos.title: Cape Queer
videos.overview: As the body count in Hackensack continues to rise, Lexy and Junior's relationship becomes strained, while Jake and his friends set a risky trap for Chucky that could have dire consequences if it backfires.

videos.title: Twice the Grieving, Double the Loss
videos.overview: As Hackensack reels from Chucky's relentless—but secret—reign of terror, the Mayor tries to allay fears by cluelessly arresting an innocent suspect. Meanwhile, the kids desperately try to figure out Chucky's mysterious endgame — before it's too late.

videos.title: An Affair to Dismember
videos.overview: Scores old and new will be settled, and sparks will fly,as Chucky's diabolical plan comes to fruition at a particularly dangerous—and public—venue.

videos.title: Halloween II
videos.overview: A year after seemingly defeating their nemesis Chucky, “3 Amigos" Jake, Devon, and Lexy begin receiving mysterious, threatening calls from an all-too-familiar-sounding enemy.

videos.title: The Sinners Are Much More Fun
videos.overview: Our 3 Amigos struggle with the strict rules and institutionalized homophobia of their new Catholic reform school, especially when Chucky arrives with a murderous agenda. Meanwhile, in Beverly Hills, a suspicious detective threatens Tiffany’s imposture as “Jennifer Tilly” and the discovery of her secret hostage, Nica Pierce.

videos.title: Hail, Mary!
videos.overview: With Jake and Devon’s relationship already under strain, the reveal that multiple killer dolls exist causes Jake to propose the unthinkable: brainwash the captured Chucky and turn him into an ally.

videos.title: Death on Denial
videos.overview: In this “very special episode of Chucky,” Tiffany’s secrets are threatened by the return from college of her 18-year-old kids Glen and Glenda, and by a surprise intervention conducted by several of Jennifer Tilly’s loved ones, who are concerned about their old friend’s odd behavior.

videos.title: Doll on Doll
videos.overview: Devon worries that Good Chucky can't be trusted; Tiffany spirals from the surprise party.

videos.title: He Is Risen Indeed
videos.overview: Incarnate Lord goes on lockdown with the Chucky dolls inside; Nica moves forward with her plan.

videos.title: Goin' to the Chapel
videos.overview: Ade due Damballa! The survivors band together with Father Bryce to perform an exorcism.

videos.title: Chucky Actually
videos.overview: Back in Hackensack for the holidays, the 3 Amigos receive a special gift. Tiffany plots her escape.

videos.title: Murder at 1600
videos.overview: No child is left behind when Chucky manages to insinuate himself into the White House and find a new "friend 'til the end" in the President's lonely young son, Henry. Meanwhile, Jake and Devon help Lexy for her missing sister Caroline.

videos.title: Let the Right One In
videos.overview: Jake, Devon and Lexy hatch a plan to take down Chucky by befriending the President's teenage son.

videos.title: Jennifer's Body
videos.overview: Chucky's complex motivations are revealed. Tiffany is tried for Jennifer Tilly's murder spree.

videos.title: Dressed to Kill
videos.overview: Jake, Devon, and Lexy infiltrate a Halloween ball to stop Chucky... but the demon doll has other plans.

videos.title: Death Becomes Her
videos.overview: Chucky wrestles with his mortality, while Jake and Devon take their romance to the next level.

videos.title: Panic Room
videos.overview: Armed with new weapons, Chucky aims to become the most prolific serial killer in history.

videos.title: There Will Be Blood
videos.overview: Parapsychologists investigate the disturbances in the White House, while Tiffany plans her escape.

videos.title: Final Destination
videos.overview: Jake faces his demons and a new type of evil in the quest to find Caroline.
